content: this is a summary of a legal case in the taurage district court the case involves a divorce between two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant the applicant is seeking the division of matrimonial property specifically a vehicle they claim that the vehicle was purchased using their own funds some of which were borrowed and therefore should be recognized as their personal property the defendant argues that they also contributed money towards the purchase of the vehicle however the court concludes that since the applicant used their own funds and borrowed funds the vehicle was purchased for their personal needs as a result the court upholds the applicants claim and declares the vehicle as their personal property the court also addresses issues related to maintenance claims and orders the defendant to pay specified costs

metadata.cost: - € 136,00 (stamp duty) + € 357,42 (proffesional fees) + € 13,28 (court fees) to be borne by the defendant
